budget.adoption: Evaluate both references per upstream and normalized margins on GLASS if expanded. Missing valid independent rule evidence for the retained GLASS variant needs resolution before adoption. An unmeasured arm-specific shift remains a PR45 prerequisite. PR45 needs one accepted regeneration per affected upstream; PR49 multiplies fresh producer costs by independent splits. Random-split OS timings and conditional bootstrap intervals cannot establish temporal performance.
budget.contrasts: Fit producers once per upstream. Compare fitting OOF vs holdout distributions by stage/route. On identical holdout rows compare full refit vs fold average with a locked arbiter, then hold upstream features fixed and compare full vs fold-averaged Meta. Use fit-side OOF Meta as the distribution reference. Track confidence, route transitions, coverage, class retention and loss. Compare GLASS rule/base rates per producing fold vs full fit. Lock rule for aggregating categorical routes before fitting. Freeze black-box results before considering GLASS.
budget.diagnostic_triggers: Apply diagnostic triggers independently inside each outer training partition using inner OOF evidence. Global Commit 3 summaries are descriptive. Exclude outer labels and predictions from activation. For route reliability, require >=20 per class in each compared state and absolute between-state voter calibration slope difference >=0.5 with the same ordering in at least two of three inner folds. Only then enable shrunk route coefficients. Enable four joint formula corners only if both a one-factor recall change and a one-factor alpha change improve inner loss by >=0.005 each. Enable one cross-fitted rule-evidence ablation only if fit-sample minus cross-fitted precision >=0.05 at >=100 routed observations in two inner folds. Unavailable leakage-safe evidence: defer that ablation; no upstream refit during screening.
budget.estimate: Provisional Windows scheduling allowances: 1-3 h black-box, another 2-6 h for conditional GLASS. These are planning ranges, not benchmarks. Time the first producer of each family, multiply by remaining fits at their actual partition sizes, and review before expansion.
budget.holdout: Commit 5 only: one stratified 20% holdout of training rows, seed 4305, black-box upstream first with accepted parameters. Lock models and cuts before holdout inspection. Expand once to GLASS if same-row full-refit vs fold-average absolute coverage difference >=0.05, either class retention difference >=0.05, absolute mean loss difference >=0.005, or a GLASS-specific rule-evidence question remains necessary for adoption. Otherwise stop after black-box and identify the unmeasured GLASS shift. Freeze black-box results before expanding; use neither holdout for retuning. The last trigger requires a retained GLASS candidate and either missing valid cross-fitted rule evidence or a >=0.05 rule-rate discrepancy meeting the registered support trigger. One upstream experiment per arm; report costs and isolate meta refit effects.
budget.independent_rules: Capture ordered rule identities, held-out matches, positives and producing base rates during five conditional GLASS producer fits. No extra fit to count held-out matches. Unseen or under-supported rules remain unresolved. A separate five-fold replay costs five more router fits if those identities cannot be retained; require review before authorizing it.
budget.maps_and_transforms: Stage 1: 111 training-local encoder/scaler designs and 11 sigmoid maps per upstream. Stage 3: 31 feature designs and 0-6 gated maps. Stage 2: six outer/full feature designs plus five label-excluded inner designs per router where required. Cache matching feature identities. Raw fixed-parameter Meta: five OOF producers and one refit, no calibration; fit the class and abstention cuts on fitting-partition OOF scores. No hyperparameter search. The accepted formula and its normalized variant share fitted voter cuts and weights.
budget.measurements: PR39 c4_20261115_204125 execution_blackbox and execution_glass_recovery wall times 4895.7 and 12675.7 s cover broader executions with different work/reuse. PR38 handoff: RF outer CV 118 s; GLASS outer CV 1192.6 s and full fit 170 s, older feature pathways.
budget.rf_forests: Each of six router fits uses five OOF forests per pass, 5x5 nested eligibility forests and two refits: 37 per router, 222 total. Do not add router-object counts to forest counts.

design: Descriptive Step 5A convention: pair row draws within outer fold and class using policy v1's secondary 95% percentile convention. Keep scores and pre-deferral decisions fixed. Evaluate locked fold cuts on the draw; reselect only a pooled deferral cut on that draw and evaluate it both on the draw and its out-of-bag rows. Cut reselection is conditional on frozen models. Matched-coverage brackets use the original outer evaluation rows. Never promote from this analysis.
interpretation: PR39 uses one historical deferral cut in both conditions. Pooled PR43 global selections and mixed interventions are same-row descriptive results. Bootstrap summaries concern operating safeguards only; probability quality, ranking, and secondary dispositions remain in Step 4B.
limitations: Nested Stage 4 only: upstream OOF inputs are fixed. Stage 2/3 inputs of outer-training rows come from producers fitted with outer-evaluation labels; Stage 1 (ten folds) producers of evaluation rows saw other evaluation rows. Upstream nested selection is PR 44. Random-split, training-only evidence: target-derived features can use later contacts' labels and MLP early stopping shared encoder fitting (PR 42). Forward-in-time claims need PR 49.

settings.limits: Conditional on the rows, prevalence, fitted OOF streams and chosen outer models. Does not measure upstream refit or time drift; folds share training rows. Coefficient intervals are descriptive: 500 paired stratified training-row bootstrap refits of the selected linear form, fixed preprocessing and penalty, seed 4303; report 2.5/97.5 percentiles and outer-fold coefficients.
settings.method: Candidate minus reference per-row realized loss. Percentile interval of paired mean differences; resample rows with replacement within outer-fold by true-class strata at their observed sizes. Reuse stage1_calibration.evidence.stratified_bootstrap_delta with identical seed, row order and strata for all contrasts. Bonferroni two-sided 98.75% intervals for the four predeclared loss contrasts; descriptive 95% intervals elsewhere. No promotion by secondary contrast. Report all five fold differences and sample SD.
